title: [FLINK-41077][rpc] Rethrow scheduled task failures in the main thread
body:
## What is the purpose of the change

`RpcEndpoint.MainThreadExecutor#schedule` runs the task as a `FutureTask`, which stores what the task throws, so the RPC actor never logs the failure and a fatal error does not exit the process, unlike for `execute()`. Details in FLINK-41077.

## Brief change log

  - Rethrow a scheduled task's failure in the main thread after it ran, unless the task was cancelled; the returned future still carries it.

## Verifying this change

This change added tests and can be verified as follows:

  - Three new tests in `RpcEndpointTest`: a `RuntimeException` and an `Error` from a runnable and a checked exception from a callable must each reach the gateway and fail the returned future. All three fail on the unmodified tree and pass with the change.
  - `RpcEndpointTest` 19 of 19, the test classes of the in-tree callers and `ResourceManagerTest` 168 of 168, flink-rpc-core 8 of 8 and flink-rpc-akka 120 of 120, none skipped.
